code_license_scope: Declared Python code license applies to independently authored implementation, never to downloaded scientific datasets.
distribution_strategy: Code-only provider: obtain checksum-pinned upstream sources on first access. Neither scientific coefficients nor fitted numerical parameters ship in wheel or sdist.

r_package.copyright_holder: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (listed in R package DESCRIPTION)
r_package.name: gigs

r_package_usage_and_packaging_basis: The GPL (>= 3) gigs R package contains the evaluated regression expressions used as a precise numerical source and validation oracle. The independent Python calculation model and separate versioned data packaging are informed by the original research articles, INTERGROWTH website, and gigs R implementation.
scientific_values_origin: The 43 fitted numerical parameters are transcribed from the published INTERGROWTH-21st regression equations as represented in the independently GPL-licensed gigs R 0.5.2 functions ig_png_mu_sigma and ig_vpns_mu_sigma. The gigs comments cite the 2015 and 2016 original studies and note that certain additional equations were supplied directly by Dr Eric Ohuma. The official INTERGROWTH standards page provides primary scientific context and charts; the independent Python implementation was numerically validated against the R functions.
standard: INTERGROWTH preterm and very preterm reference equations

validation.independent_oracle: Pinned original gigs R 0.5.2 functions and 4,970 continuous computed comparison values
validation.input_origin: INTERGROWTH-21st original published regression equations and fitted parameters as reproduced in gigs R 0.5.2
validation.limitations: Only four preterm-postnatal and three very-preterm birth models are covered; other INTERGROWTH standards are not implemented.
